method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. 'AVENUE M' is lettered vertically inside the roadway I measured on both plates - sheet 85 at native x~2197 (view 2 far east, view 3 far west) and sheet 94 at native x~174 (view 1 far west, immediately east of the '93' margin reference for the adjoining sheet). HUNDRED-BLOCK BREAK. On BOTH sheets Ave M is the 1200/1300 break. Sheet 85: the column WEST of it reads 1201 1203 1205 1207 1209 1211 1213 1215 1217 1219 1221 1223 along 41ST ST and 1202 1204 ... 1224 along 42ND ST (blocks 40, 41, containing the Russian Orthodox Greek Church and parsonage), and the column EAST of it reads 1301 1303 1305 1307 1309 1311 1313 1315 1317 1319 1321 1323 / 1302 1304 ... 1324 (N.W. 9 and N.E. 8 quarters of the outlots). Sheet 94: the column EAST of it carries the same 1301 1303 ... 1323 / 1302 1304 ... 1324 run (N.W. 8 and N.E. 7 quarters); its west side is the sheet edge, with sheet 93 continuing the 1200 block off-plate. ONE BLOCK EAST EXCLUDED, AND USED AS THE CHECK. That corridor is lettered 'AVENUE M 1/2' on both plates (sheet 85 centre native ~3195, sheet 94 centre native ~1171) and it is the 1300/1400 break, not the 1200/1300 break: on sheet 94 view 2 the column east of Ave M 1/2 reads 1401 1403 1405 1407 1409 1411 1413 1415 1417 1419 1421 1423 / 1402 1404 ... 1424, and on sheet 85 the whole 1301-1324 run lies BETWEEN Ave M and Ave M 1/2. Because M 1/2 is lettered and address-pinned on both plates it doubles as an independent control, and it agrees - see CORROBORATION. ONE BLOCK WEST EXCLUDED. On sheet 85 the next corridor west of Ave M is Ave L, about 1000 px west and carrying the 1100/1200 break, so it cannot be the 1200/1300 line; the 1201-1224 run lies between it and Ave M. On sheet 94 there is no corridor west of Ave M at all - Ave M is the westernmost avenue on the plate (its west casing sits only 23 px inside the map border) and the margin prints '93' there - so a one-block-west match is not even available on sheet B. NEAR-EQUAL-NATIVE-X TRAP, EXPLICITLY REJECTED - THIS PAIR IS TWO BLOCKS OFFSET. Measured avenue centres at mid-sheet: sheet 85 ... Ave M=2196.9, Ave M 1/2=~3195 (keymap J,K,L,M,M 1/2); sheet 94 Ave M=174.3, Ave M 1/2=~1171, Ave N=2171.0, Ave N 1/2=~3170 (keymap M,M 1/2,N,N 1/2). Sheet 85's Ave M (2196.9) lies within 25.9 px of sheet 94's Ave N (2171.0), and sheet 85's Ave M 1/2 (~3195) within ~25 px of sheet 94's Ave N 1/2 (~3170). Matching on native x - or on current mosaic proximity, which inherits the same error - would therefore tie Ave M to Ave N and shear this row by TWO full blocks, about 2000 px. This is the same failure flagged for pair 86/94. Only the lettering and the 1200/1300 versus 1400/1500 address runs decide it: sheet 94's corridor at 2171 is lettered 'AVENUE N.' with the 1401-1424 run on its west face and 1501 1503 1505 / 1502 1504 1506 on its east face, which is not the 1200/1300 break. CORROBORATION. The two lettered avenues the plates share give the same shift: Ave M 174.3-2196.9 = -2022.6 px, and Ave M 1/2 ~1171 - ~3195 = -2024, agreeing to about 1.5 px where a one-block error would be ~1000 px and the trap error ~2000 px. The internal lattice is consistent on each plate (sheet 85 M to M 1/2 = 998.2 px; sheet 94 M to M 1/2 = 996.7 px, M 1/2 to N = 1000.1 px). Drafted roadway width for Ave M is 211.2 native px on sheet 85 and 211.2 on sheet 94, matching the 70' printed beside it; the mid-block alleys through the outlot quarters measure only ~59 px and are printed '20'' with a water-pipe size, so no alley was mistaken for the avenue. Stacking confirmed: sheet 85's bottom margin prints '94' and sheet 94's top margin prints '85', with 42ND ST the shared seam. WHY Ave M AND NOT Ave M 1/2 IS REPORTED. Ave M is drawn complete on both plates and was measurable in all seven y bands on each. Ave M 1/2 is clipped by sheet 85's east border (only its west casing at native 3089.2 is drawn, so its centre there is an inference of west+105.9) and on sheet 94 its casings are drawn only in the upper third of the plate, where the outlot quarters are subdivided. Ave M 1/2 is therefore used as the cross-check above rather than as the reported control. NOTE ON THE RED MARKER. The red line in each crop is only the crop centre (native 832 / 1664 / 2495) and lands mid-block; the offered candidates (85: 2755/1712/670, 94: 512/1552/2593) are not lettered avenues either. The reported values are roadway centrelines - the midpoint of the two facing block lines - measured against the native pixel grid the green ruler labels. MEASUREMENT CONVENTION. Each centreline was measured in seven y bands from y=600 to y=3400, fitted linearly and evaluated at the sheet's vertical mid-height y=1949 (scan-rotation drift is +0.0028 px/row on sheet 85 and -0.0024 px/row on sheet 94). Reading instead in the bands adjacent to the shared 42ND ST seam gives 85 M=2200.9 / 94 M=177.7, a shift of -2023.2 against -2022.6, so the tilt contributes under 1 px of uncertainty here.
